Option A is incorrect because three APIs are unnecessary and add a merging layer. Option B is incorrect because it works only by rebuilding authentication logic that the built-in modes already provide. Option C is incorrect because a shared API key does not identify users or services and does not enforce IAM. Takeaway: AppSync supports multiple authorization modes on one API.

questions.question: A company suspects that many of its Amazon EC2 instances are larger than they need to be. The company wants recommendations for smaller or different instance types that are based on the instances' historical CloudWatch utilization metrics, and it wants the recommendations to show the estimated risk of underprovisioning. Which service should the company use?
options: Amazon Inspector
AWS Compute Optimizer
AWS Cost Explorer forecasting
AWS Config
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization metrics and recommends optimal instance types, with performance risk and estimated savings for each recommendation. Option A is incorrect because Inspector scans for vulnerabilities and exposure. Option C is incorrect because Cost Explorer forecasting projects future spending and does not recommend instance types. Option D is incorrect because Config records resource configurations and compliance and does not analyze utilization. Takeaway: use Compute Optimizer for rightsizing recommendations.

questions.question: An Amazon EFS file system stores project files, and most of the files are not accessed after 30 days. The company wants to reduce storage cost without changing the applications, and files must still be accessible through the same mount path when needed. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: Convert the file system to Provisioned Throughput mode so that idle files are charged less
Enable EFS lifecycle management to transition files to the EFS Infrequent Access storage class after 30 days
Copy files older than 30 days to Amazon S3 with a script and delete them from the file system
Change the file system to a One Zone file system to use a lower storage price for all files
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because lifecycle management moves files that have not been accessed for the chosen period to a lower-cost storage class while they remain available under the same paths. Option A is incorrect because throughput mode affects performance charges and does not lower the cost of stored data. Option C is incorrect because moving files to S3 changes how applications access them and needs custom scripting. Option D is incorrect because a One Zone file system reduces availability by using a single Availability Zone and lowers the price for all data, not only cold files. Takeaway: use EFS lifecycle management for cold data.

questions.question: An Amazon EMR cluster runs Spark jobs whose demand varies during the day. The team wants to add capacity at the lowest cost without risking loss of the data that is stored in HDFS on the cluster. Which TWO actions meet these requirements? (Select TWO)
options: Run the primary node as a Spot Instance to lower the cost of the cluster controller
Run the core nodes as Spot Instances to reduce the cost of HDFS storage
Run the core nodes as On-Demand Instances so that HDFS data is stored on stable capacity
Add task nodes that use Spot Instances to provide extra compute capacity
Add core nodes that use Spot Instances and reduce the HDFS replication factor to one
questions.explanation: Options C and D are correct. Core nodes store HDFS data and should be on stable capacity, while task nodes run only compute and can safely use Spot capacity because losing them does not lose data. Option A is incorrect because a primary node interruption terminates the cluster. Option B is incorrect because a Spot interruption of a core node can lose HDFS blocks. Option E is incorrect because lowering replication and using Spot core nodes increases the chance of data loss. Takeaway: put stateful roles on On-Demand and stateless task capacity on Spot.
